CustomField.label: Offering Key
CustomField.description: Which GTM offering this assessment was scored against. Set once, server-side, at insert -- never client-supplied. Matches GTM_Offering__mdt.Offering_Key__c. Deliberately required=false: this object already holds real production rows with no value here yet; see scripts/data/backfill-assessment-offering-key.apex and ADR-0007 section 3 for why this stays optional at the schema level rather than being flipped to required after backfill.
